This produces less heat and takes longer than a similar model that’s rated at less power. My old dryer had three settings high, low and air dry. This one has high (low), energy saver (air dry) and air dry. It’s annoying that it is not as hot as a nearly identical Conway dryer. It also started making squeaking noises after 2 months. Was hoping for at least equal quality and slightly more power than my old model, but this basically has no heat at all unless it’s set to high and then takes the full cycle to dry a half load. Good thing I kept the smaller less powerful dryer because it’s hotter and faster. Definitely worse than the Cosway brand it replaced. Worse, about every two weeks you need to unscrew the back and reset the floppy and cheap belt, otherwise is just some heat at all, with air dry as the only option.
I love my little dryer.  It works like a pro.  It's so little,  cute, and absolutely powerful.

Perfect for small units - operates beautifully and has a sleek design which I love.  Has a variety of settings to choose from, including an ECO Mode that saves energy by beginning the drying cycle with cool air and changing to hot air setting. Wonderful product!

Just received my Black & Decker BCED37 Portable Dryer today. It came in a day earlier than expected.  This machine was very well packaged, the way it was packaged, I believe it could have fallen off the truck at 60 miles per hour and would have survived. No Fuss setup and works remarkable.  No More Hanging Clothes to Dry.  If you live in a small space, need a dryer and are on the fence about buying, "GET OFF THE FENCE" this dryer is well worth the money.

Can't complain, it dries my clothes. The only thing that I thought was wacky is the heat settings. The timer knob is so basic and not the wisest design. You get 200 minutes total if you'd wish- However, only 80 of those minutes are on the warm to hot temp and then the twmp starts coooling down as the minutes reduce.... and then here's the genius bonus they threw in- you get a seperate cool cycle on another option....

So basically, if you actually want to DRY your clothes, you have to set it all the way to 200 minuyes, and keep rewinding it every hour or so, so that the timer doesnt run into the "cool" minutes from 120-0....

If you look at the photo of the Dial, the grey minutes are the "cool" cycle... The red minutes are the actual warm drying cycle, and the blue minutes are another cool cycle they decided to tack onto the hot cycles. Yeah, go figure.

Amazing dryer for those who need 120 volt standard outlet, or to save space. This unit replaced our old one. And it is night and day the the last one. Powerful, great heat, ample options and holds a lot more than I imagined. It dries so we'll, it's hard to believe it's 120 volt unit. Highly recommend.
One sidenote. When I 1st plugged it it, it came on, got hot, but did not spin. I simply took the screws to the back off and saw the belt that goes around the entire drum had come off in shipping. Wasn't broken, just slipped off the drum. I carefully placed it back around the drum, threw the screws back on and boom. Works perfectly.
The dryer is bulky . It takes a long time to dry and have to be adjusting to the hot setting. Maybe I need to split my load . I’ll keep using for now.
I got sent two broken ones before a working one arrived.  And then the working one I did get was dented all over the place.  It’s just completely obnoxious.
Loved the compact size. Loved the drying power. Remember to clean the lint trap after each use. It is not too bad but it is worth it to have dry clothes quickly.
This product is great for the price. On the down side I think it’s a bit bulky, if I had a closet to hide it in I would love. It’s not super heavy and is easy to move.

I have 2 kids and this has just made life 10x easier.  Don't hesitate make the purchase and get your sanity back.  There's plenty of settings so you can adjust the temp for any clothing.  Only con I'd say is the filter on the lint catcher is a pain lol but I'm happy to deal with that then spend time and money at a mat.

I like a lot about this compact dryer. It's a little noisy on startup but quiet when running. It takes about the same time to dry normal clothes as my local laundry mat. Large blankets and towels however need to be dried separately and sometimes one at a time if you want to save on time and power. The lint removal system is good but you have to check it every two loads to empty the lint trap. Pretty decent dryer for the price.

This is a fantastic little dryer! We needed a dryer to fit an extremely small space because it was an after thought. Being empty nesters, we typically line dry our clothes. (Life is much simpler with the 6 children gone.) I absolutely love the smell of lined dried clothes. The towels? That's another issue. I'm not a fan of how hard they get from air drying on the line. Of course, when it rains for days at a time, I'm not a fan of clothing strung out all over the house either.

So our difficult search began. If you notice, the reviews on almost anything has declined over the last two years. This plandemic has cause a decrease in appliance quality while prices skyrocketed so reviews scare you to death. Plus, be careful. Appliances from big box stores are now NON REFUNDABLE. READ THE FINE PRINT. I found this little dryer and gave it a try because I had nothing to lose.

It has its pros and cons, just like anything else.

PROS: It's a Black & Decker with a better, long-standing reputation than a small Chinese company with no customer service. Dryers are typically one of the largest energy expenses in the house. Not this baby. It's a 110!! No need for a 220 outlet and uses significantly less energy, even if the cycle takes a bit longer to dry. You can plug her in basically anywhere and not need an electrician. With a handy person, she can live on the shelf and save floor space! While being small, she can still hold small loads. I absolutely love this little dryer! I love it doesn't require the huge plug, it dries great, and fits my blankets and sheets just fine. Decent for the price for sure.

I bought this from Amazon warehouse. It was heavily dented on the left side and the drum would not spin.  Instead of sending it back, I used a claw hammer to bang the dent out. The drum started to spin and I haven't had any complaints since. This portable dryer is made of thin a light materials and it needs to be packaged and shipped with more care. Mechanically the dryer works great and with the refurbished discount I feel like I got a great deal.  I've looked inside of it and there are only a few parts that are easily replaceable.  It is the frame and drum that you have to be concerned with. If either of them is out of alignment then send the dryer back.  My dryer is heavily dented but I didn't buy it for it's good looked. The most time I spent with it was getting the legs to balance

[[VIDEOID:d3957a6c0bb5de942a459ed745042dc3]] I got a defective / damaged unit. First, I noticed a large dent on the edge when I opened the package. The metal frame was dented so dryer air was escaping, check out my photos. The gap in frame would make this unit very inefficient. Second, when I turned it on to see how it functioned, it made a loud scraping noise, it didnt sound normal at all. I am sure a new good working one would be nice to own as it has good button options and the size is nice compared to similar 120v electric dryers in this dryer class.

After having to order a second one due to negligence and losing the shipment by ups,I received my dryer .well pleased with it and it's operation.  Will save me time and money over our apt complex washroom

I was shopping around for a dryer for a long time. I live in an apartment and I don’t know if I’m going to be moving within the next two years. I live in California so most apartments out here don’t have a washer dryer hook up. I decided to go with this dryer because it gives me versatility. I can bring it wherever I go. It fits large blankets, multiple towels and big loads of laundry. it works very well. The only downside are the dryer vent cover things, that you need to replace. You can clean them probably up to 10 or 15 times before it’s unusable. I use a lint roller when I clean them, they CANNOT be washed. Replacements are really cheap, they’re only about 10$ And that should last you well over a year. It’s just a tedious task, beside that it’s a wonderful dryer. I’ve only had it for about four or five months but it’s been working fantastic. I have three dogs tons of hair and it’s very good with all that we got. My clothes are in fantastic condition and it does not over dry.

Perfect for small spaces and studio apartments. Also, if you live alone this is the perfect size for one person. So far have had no issues and everything comes out nice and dry!

Side note: I would definitely get some kind of tube or vent (I ordered a 4" diameter that fits perfect over the vent) to divert the humidity thru a window or outdoors though. It was too much moisture for my small bathroom.
Great for small spaces

I honestly wasn't betting the farm that this would work very well, and instead be the Easy Bake version of a dryer. However, it surprised me. It's a perfect little dryer that holds more than you would think, and works really well.
I purchased this for my house hold of 4. Easy to use takes time to dry clothes but as long as you follow guide about the amount of laundry it’s perfect.

Drying time is as expected.  It does take a little longer than a full-size dryer, but not a lot because the loads are smaller.  It does heat up the house quite a bit.  It's light and easy to move around if needed.  The settings are on the bottom so they are a little hard to see unless you can put the dryer on a countertop.  Perfect companion to the matching washer.

Unless your mechanically inclined, I would not buy this. It’s fine until it stops working and eventually it will have problems.

If you call black n decker they will ask for a receipt for warranty. If you have none, there’s nothing they can do for you. They can’t even point you to a repair technician for their own products. As of 3/23 the machine works but cuts on and off when using heat. Air dry works fine through entire cycle.

It’s also hard to find parts for this model and other portable machines.

EDIT: the YouTube channel how-2-repair.com has a detailed video on how to take apart the panda dryer and replace certain parts. It’s similar to black and decker except on b&d there’s screws on the vent that need to be removed to remove the drum. The video is helpful if you want to try and repair it.

Some things like the drum not moving can be fixed by replacing the belt. Other things like what I’m dealing with, I need the part.

If B&D wants people to buy this, make it easier for people to get support with this. Most Appliance mechanics don’t work on these so what’s a customer to do? Granted it has trouble with a large load but does get the job done when drying smaller loads.

I purchased this dryer to match my Black & Decker washer. It is a great edition to have in an apt that does not come with a washer and dryer hookup. The plug is designed to fit the standard wall outlet which is great!

Love this dryer! After going every week to the laundromat with my 3 little ones I decided to invest in an apartment size washer and dryer. This little dryer gets hot and dries my clothes quickly. Honestly completely worth the price. I have it in my kitchen venting out my window.

I use this for a family of four. Drying does take longer than what a regular dryer would, but that's to be expected. Easy to clean, and I 100% recommend if you live in a place like mine that has no washer/dryer connections.

I really liked this dryer for the ~12 weeks I used it after purchase, and before it broke.

First the timer broke, and it ran for 5 hours overnight when I set it to dry before bedtime. I only noticed because I woke up in the middle of the night and it was still running. That's a definite safety/fire hazard, and I'm lucky I didn't leave it on timed dry before going to work for a full day! And no, it wasn't user error, it had been set to auto-off at 120 minutes. After that point I had to set a timer on my phone and stop the clothes myself when they were dry.

A few weeks later it stopped drying as well, and clothes were still damp and barely warm after even 2-3 hours.

Last, it just completely broke. Shut off in the middle of a drying cycle and never turned back on.

IMPORTANT: This dryer has a "warranty" but they won't honor it.

I purchased a protection plan from Assurant (I DO NOT RECOMMEND) and they said since the dryer was still under warranty to contact B&D. Ok, cool.

Contacted B&D and they said they actually don't manage this particular item. Appears that they just slapped their label on an item made by a third-party company.

Contacted "W Appliance" and got zero response on phone or email.

Contacted Assurant again, they said since I didn't have a resolution from the manufacturer about the warranty, they couldn't help me.

In sum: If you buy this, make sure it is shipped and sold

I didn’t know how it would work for me but it blew all my expectations. It’s easy to setup, it’s quiet, and just in case you are picky, it’s cute. I hang my wet clothes on the clothes line and then throw into the dryer to finish them off. If I put 10 pairs of underwear and 10 pairs of socks into the dryer it takes about 90 minutes to dry. So as long as you can hang your clothes to dry or don't mind waiting a long time it's perfect. I don't regret the purchase. The portable washer I bought with this dryer (also Black & Decker) works amazing. One load in the washer is about 3 drying loads in the dryer. Also, the filter is a little fiddly to remove from the back of the dryer and remove the lint. Again, not really complaining as it does what it's suppose to do and I have the luxury of not leaving my house!

I cannot believe how well this dryer works! The only con is it did not come with an exhaust vent hose, but you can get an indoor one for less than $20. I just dried a king comforter a king Throw, 2 king pillow cases, and 2 pairs of pants all at the same time. It works great for me!

I love my portable dryer. We live in an apartment where we only have washing machine hook up, so this dryer is a life saver for my family of five.

It's so small, but holds a lot! Gets things dry without burning my clothes like the laundromat dryers do. It took a moment to figure out the knob, but that was user error as I did not read the whole manual at first. I purchased an indoor vent kit to go with this, and it's been a huge time and space saver!
